title: About SEYIK
intro: Skill & Equip Youth Initiative for Karamoja (SEYIK) is a youth-led organisation dedicated to skilling and equipping young people across the Karamoja Sub-Region of Uganda.
mission: To skill and equip the youth of Karamoja for inclusive economic growth while tackling climate change issues.
vision: A generation of empowered Karamoja youth who are skilled, resilient, and leading positive change in their communities and beyond.
